title: Core Web Vitals & Speed Optimization
subtitle: Achieve lightning-fast load times for better SEO rankings and higher conversions. We optimize images, code, and servers to pass Google's Core Web Vitals.
description: Start with the slow pages or actions your users report. We can review images, scripts, caching and server response, then identify which changes belong in the quote.

intro.title: What will you measure and deliver?
intro.text: We record a baseline for agreed pages and interactions. The proposal separates the audit and implementation, identifies any access needed, and explains how we will verify the work.

0.title: Reproduce reported delays
0.description: We use a repeatable test to identify what slows the affected page or interaction.

1.title: Verify the work after release
1.description: Compare results for the same pages and settings. We label lab results separately from field data when both are available.

2.title: Better User Experience
2.description: Users hate waiting. A snappy website keeps visitors engaged, lowers bounce rates, and builds trust in your brand.

3.title: Save on Hosting Costs
3.description: Optimized code uses fewer server resources. This means your site can handle more traffic without needing expensive server upgrades.

0.title: Deep Performance Audit
0.description: We analyze every file, script, and query to find exactly what is slowing you down, establishing a baseline score.

1.title: Code & Asset Optimization
1.description: We minify code, compress images, and defer non-essential scripts to make the initial load instant.

2.title: Server-Side Tuning
2.description: We configure advanced caching (Redis/Varnish) and CDNs to serve your content from the edge, closest to your users.

3.title: Verify the work after release
3.description: Compare results for the same pages and settings. We label lab results separately from field data when both are available.
